exposure: Lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness measured by transabdominal ultrasound
cohort: 126 pregnant women aged 18-40 years with a live singleton fetus in vertex presentation at term, with a history of prior cesarean section.
finding: A LUS thickness of ≤2mm measured by transabdominal ultrasound showed a high sensitivity (93%) and negative predictive value (93%) for evaluating the risk of uterine dehiscence.
gest_age: Term (median gestational age 35 weeks, range 34-37 weeks)
